entries.ro: <mothertongue l="bra" m="Oi, ei!" b="" a=" Hei!"/>

entries.en: I am sorry, but which street is this?
entries.ro: Îmi pare rău, dar ce stradă e asta?

entries.en: Where are you...? I think I... No... I can't see you...!
entries.ro: Unde ești...? Cred că... Nu... Nu te văd...!

entries.en: Aha...! Typical of you... Fine, I'll wait... It's OK... Don't worry, I have time.
entries.ro: Aha...! Tipic pentru tine... Bine, aștept... E în regulă... Nu-ți face griji, am timp.

entries.en: <mothertongue l="bra" m="Jesus Cristo," b="" a=" what's going on?!"/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="bra" m="Jesus Cristo," b="" a=" ce se întâmplă?!"/>

entries.en: Is everything OK? Do you need something?
entries.ro: Totul e în regulă? Ai nevoie de ceva?

entries.en: Does it look like I need company?
entries.ro: Arăt ca cineva care are nevoie de companie?

entries.en: Yes, I checked...! For Christ's sake!
entries.ro: Da, am verificat...! Doamne, pe bune!

entries.en: What is it with these Americans...
I was saying something... Oh, yes.
